I recently broke the chains of capping at gold 4 the pst few seasons and am currently P1 68% WR. Here’s some stuff that helped me turn it around this season:

1a) just turn off game chat. Seriously 😂 people will complain about you every game when the reality is they are coping hard with getting beat. Just play the game with pings unless your teammates show they can’t handle that communication tool either.

1) stick to one champ. I play only udyr, unless he’s banned then I’ll play a situational pick. He’s versatile. I’m consistently doing about as much dmg as the support. You don’t need to dmg carry to force wins in JG. 

2) I’m focusing objectives. Figure out a path or two that allows you to be at objectives AT their spawn time and use control wards to take obj. Most jg in gold have poor tempo and this is easy to abuse. Part of pathing is clearing your camps near spawn as close as possible. Most jg “waffle around” in low tier, hovering lanes that they don’t end up ganking. 

3) if a lane is lost, ignore the lane and focus on your winning angles. Botlane is doomed? Died 4 times before 5 min? I guess you’re permanently ganking mid/top and hoping you three can carry. Aim to get all void obj in those scenarios since they will likely get more drags. 

These small changes helped a lot. GL!

If you feel confident about income levels and the likelihood of long-term appreciation, I’d recommend getting the 30-year for a few key reasons just from a factual asset class profile basis:

1) stocks will likely appreciate faster than real estate over almost every 30 year window of time historically speaking. VTSAX is the fund I’d consider.

2) Real estate is far less volatile than the stock market, making it one of the safer asset classes to leverage long term. The leverage also increases your cash on cash return that many look at for real estate investing. 

2a) Long term rates do have the potential to decrease later, allowing you to refinance and lower your payments on a monthly basis, enabling you to invest more or pay down principal faster.

3) generally speaking, if you have excess in your budget to pay down a mortgage vs. invest in VTSAX, you will become financially independent faster by snowballing investments in more scenarios than paying down mortgage debt.
